text: Polygenic risk scores (PRS) are likely to enter routine clinical care for individual disease risk prediction in the next 10 years. We recently showed that the bone mineral density-associated gSOS-PRS is independently associated with a > 4-fold increased risk of osteoporosis in the Swiss HIV Cohort Study (SHCS). Here we investigate whether this PRS is also associated with low trauma fractures (LTF) in people with HIV in the SHCS.
source_label: Association of a polygenic risk score with low trauma fractures in people with HIV – The swiss HIV cohort study
